title: Evaluation of a bit source
statement: Given an input list $x$ of Boolean values and a list $b$ of Boolean blocks, evaluate a bit source as follows: input index $k$ reads $x_k$, using false if unavailable; a constant source returns its Boolean value; and block source $(i,j)$ reads bit $j$ of block $i$, using an empty block or false bit when the requested entry is unavailable.
